scoring_change.summary: Daily (setup_timeframe == 1D) setups now score on SPY/QQQ daily-trend alignment (setup_market_status == VALID -> +4 market_alignment) instead of the 30-minute VWAP/EMA20 checks (against_vwap/against_trend), which were vetoing 30 of 64 Daily rows that reached the Discord decision since 2026-09-08 on sub-0.1% intraday wobbles. 30-minute setup scoring is byte-for-byte unchanged. This changes Discord alert eligibility only -- OPTIONS_PAPER_V1 (paper_v1.py) never reads the scanner score, so no paper-policy, risk, or contract-selection rule changed.

deployed_sha_note: This epoch's deployed_sha/release_live_at/scanner_restart_at describe the code actually running at epoch_start (aea0df0), not the first release that shipped the scoring change. Timeline: PR #869 (Daily scorer alignment) went live on scanner-only curated release dd3aa9d at 2026-09-21T04:21:21Z; #870 (dashboard readability, unrelated to scoring) followed on release 75b2687 at 04:26:32Z. A pre-existing SignaContextStore SQLite connection leak (introduced by #802, merged 2026-09-20, exposed once the #870 dashboard began polling /shadow-journal/status every minute) saturated the process's 1024-fd ulimit at 2026-09-21T07:55:46Z; every scheduled scan from then failed with 'unable to open database file' -- ZERO scans were recorded 2026-09-21T07:55Z-19:18Z. Two same-release restarts (pid 1164159 at 15:22Z, pid 1178028 at 17:22Z) temporarily cleared the fd count but did not fix the leak and were not treated as epoch starts. PR #888 fixed the leak (SignaContextStore._connect is now a closing contextmanager); scanner-only release aea0df0 (75b2687 + #888) deployed 19:18:07Z; fd count verified flat (15->15) over 50 synthetic /shadow-journal+/status polls and stayed flat (15->16) through the following 6 real scheduled cycles. epoch_start is the first of those clean cycles. Rows in the 07:55Z-19:18Z outage window simply do not exist; the boundary below is defined purely by timestamp, same convention as the epoch-1/epoch-2 boundary.

cohort_boundary.note: rows with timestamp < epoch_start are epoch-2 evidence (or fall inside the 07:55Z-19:18Z outage and do not exist); rows at or after it are epoch-3 evidence
